subject: Vendor security questionnaire onboarding & evidence triage
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <security@finly.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T15:24:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor security questionnaire onboarding & evidence triage

Hi Alex — great to speak earlier. Quick recap from our discovery call and the asks we discussed so we have alignment on next steps: 

Summary from call:
- Finly is evaluating Redwood for customer support automation and transactional embeddings.
- Primary compliance concerns: SOC 2 Type II status, GDPR DPA, and HIPAA handling for a subset of PII.
- Finly prefers a CAIQ-form prefill but is open to SIG-Lite if it reduces lift.

Pending items / clarifying questions for security intake:
1) SOC 2 timing: you mentioned SOC 2 Type II report is in progress. Can you confirm the expected completion quarter and whether there is an interim SOC 2 Type I or SOC 2 readiness report available?
2) Data residency: confirm whether any Finly customer data would be restricted to EU residency for this POC.
3) HIPAA scope: will Finly require a Business Associate Agreement for the pilot, or only for full production?
4) Questionnaire path: you preferred CAIQ — do you want us to send a prefilled CAIQ spreadsheet (we can do a first pass) or start with SIG-Lite to unblock quick review?

What I can provide immediately:
- Attached: Redwood SIG starter guide (brief), and I can send a CAIQ prefill if you confirm that path.
- Proposed timeline: if you send CAIQ now, our security team can do an initial prefill + evidence pull in ~3 business days; SIG-Lite path often shortens to 1–2 business days for the intake phase.

Next steps I suggest:
- You confirm preferred questionnaire (CAIQ vs SIG-Lite).
- Identify your security contact for evidence uploads (SFTP/SharePoint/Drive).
- If legal needs a DPA, Ben (cc) can coordinate a DPA template and faster turnaround.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the prefill once you confirm the path.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
(t) 415-555-0198

From: Alex Rivera <security@finly.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor security questionnaire onboarding & evidence triage

Tessa — thanks for the detailed recap and for the attachments. Quick answers below and attached a starting CAIQ prefill we completed on our side.

Answers / notes:
- SOC 2: We have SOC 2 Type II in progress, expected completion end of Q3 2027 (target: 2027-09-30). No formal Type I yet; we do have a readiness report from our external assessor (I attached the one-page readiness summary).
- Data residency: For the POC, no EU residency requirement — all POC traffic will stay in US regions. If we go to production, a subset of enterprise customers may require EU residency.
- HIPAA: For pilots with synthetic or de-identified data we don’t require a full BAA. For any production ingest of PHI, we will need a BAA.
- Questionnaire path: We prefer the CAIQ prefill route. I attached our CAIQ_preferred_answers.xlsx — would appreciate a Redwood prefill to speed triage.

Evidence owner and uploads: Security intake will be handled by me (security@finly.com). I can accept a shared drive link or an S3 presigned upload. If there are specific evidence artifacts you need (e.g., encryption key management screenshots, SOC 2 controls mapping), list them and I’ll prioritize.

We don’t need a DPA pre-sign for the POC, but legal will request one if we advance to an enterprise PO.

Thanks — I’ll ping when I’ve uploaded the CAIQ file to the link you provide.

—Alex
Alex Rivera
Head of Security, Finly Inc.
security@finly.com
[attachment: Finly_CAQi_prefill.xlsx]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor security questionnaire onboarding & evidence triage

Tessa / Jordan — thanks for the heads-up. Quick notes from Legal & Security ops: 

- DPA: If Finly confirms POC only, we can hold on DPA signature. If they move to production or request customer data residency guarantees, Legal will need to start the DPA and data processing clause review. I attached the current DPA template link in the related_links field for reference.
- CAIQ prefill: Security ops can do an initial prefill for external questionnaires. Provide the CAIQ you received from Finly; ops will annotate the fields we can self-attest and mark evidence owners.
- Evidence collection: For anything that requires screenshots or platform-specific artifacts (KMS screenshots, config exports), ops will request access or a one-time upload link. We prefer an S3 presigned-url flow for large artifacts.

Operational ask: Tessa, could you request the CAIQ to be uploaded to the HubSpot secured intake folder (link above) and confirm the format (xlsx vs csv)? If Finly uploads an xlsx we’ll take that first.

If Finly needs accelerated review for an upcoming board/contract deadline, Legal can prioritize but we’ll need a short note on timeline — Ben will take it.

Ben Carter
Head of Legal Ops | Redwood Inference
[attachment stub: redwood_SIG_starter_guide.pdf]

From: Alex Rivera <security@finly.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor security questionnaire onboarding & evidence triage

Thanks everyone — uploaded the CAIQ (Finly_CAQi_prefill.xlsx) to the HubSpot secured intake folder and left a note in the document with ownership suggestions. We expect to have the detailed evidence bundle available by 2027-05-07 for the prefill review.

A couple quick clarifications:  
- Can Redwood provide an initial mapping table (question -> likely Redwood owner) with the prefill so we can align internal reviewers?
- For KMS screenshots, we will only share redacted metadata (e.g., key identifiers) — is that acceptable for your ops review?

If you confirm CAIQ path, we’ll schedule a short sync (30 min) to walk evidence owners through the expectations. Jordan — can you propose 30-min slots tomorrow or Friday?

—Alex
